item.description:
1. AgentKit by Scalekit

Tagline: MCP gateway for production agents that acts on your behalf
Description: Let your agents use 30,000+ tools across 600+ apps, from Salesforce to GitHub, through one MCP gateway. AgentKit handles auth and integrations, so every action runs as the user who asked, within the scopes they granted. Give each agent only the tools its job needs with Virtual MCP Servers. Add internal APIs as custom connectors. Use Triggers to start an agent the moment an email lands. Built for developers taking agents to production: every call is logged. Free tier: 10,000 tool calls a month.
Website: open
Product Hunt: View on Product Hunt

Keyword: MCP Gateway, AI Agents, Agent Infrastructure, Tool Integration, API Connectors, Virtual MCP, Event Triggers, Auth Management, Custom Integrations, Developer Platform, AI Automation, Model Context Protocol, Agent Logging, Scalekit

2. Teamily AI

Tagline: Your personal agent, agent teams & people in one messenger
Description: The human-agent platform where people and always-on agents get work done together in one unified, context-aware space. Unlike single-user personal agents, Teamily AI enables multi-user, multi-agent teamwork. Built on an AI-native messenger, it connects people, agents, docs, meetings, calls, workflows, and business systems to automate office work and customer service. Agents become real teammates with persistent memory, proactive intelligence, and continuous self-improvement. Free to get started.
